Your Coaches

MEET THE SPEAKERS

Evanna LowAI Trainer & Educator

Evanna brings practical AI knowledge made accessible for everyday learners. Her sessions break down complex tools into simple, actionable skills you can use immediately.

You will

  • How to use AI tools to your advantage
  • Prompting strategies for students
  • AI for research, writing, and prep
Mason PhoonCommunication Coach

Mason is an award-winning communicator and recognised student leader whose work has earned him a Best Project Award at Monash University Malaysia in 2024. With a proven track record in public speaking — from leading Science Week physics exhibitions to competing on stage — he brings practical, high-impact training to help you speak clearly, boldly, and memorably.

You will

The Curriculum

WHAT YOU WALK AWAY WITH

🎤
Vocal Foundations
Master volume, rate of speech, melody, tonality, and the power of the pause — the five tools every great speaker uses.
🧠
Fear Management
Turn nervous energy into presence. Learn practical techniques to manage anxiety before and during high-stakes moments.
👨‍👩‍👧
Legacy Influence
Discover how effective communication shapes the way you guide and raise the next generation — building lasting influence through the words you choose and the presence you carry.
🎯
Presentation Skills
From classroom slides to stage presentations — learn how to hold attention and communicate ideas that land.
🙋
Q&A Mastery
Learn how to think on your feet, handle unexpected questions with composure, and turn every Q&A into a moment that builds your credibility.
🤝
Lunch & Networking
Connect with like-minded peers and professionals over lunch from 12PM before the session begins at 1PM.

认识你的讲师

讲师介绍

Evanna LowAI培训师 & 教育者

Evanna 将实用的AI知识化繁为简，让每位学员都能轻松掌握。她的课程将复杂的工具拆解成简单可操作的技能，让你立刻学以致用。

你会学到

  • 如何善用AI工具提升效率
  • 适合学生的提示词技巧

Mason Phoon沟通教练

Mason 是一位屡获殊荣的沟通达人，也是备受认可的学生领袖。他于2024年荣获马来西亚莫纳什大学最佳项目奖，从主导科学周物理展览到登台演讲比赛，他将实战经验转化为高效培训，助你清晰、大胆、令人难忘地表达自我。

你会学到

  • 学习五大声音基础
  • 掌握恐惧管理技巧

你会学到

课程收获

🎤
声音基础五要素
掌握音量、语速、旋律、语调与停顿 — 每位出色演讲者都在使用的五大工具。
🧠
恐惧管理
将紧张转化为气场。学习实用技巧，在高压时刻前后有效管理焦虑情绪。
👨‍👩‍👧
传承影响力
了解有效沟通如何塑造你引导与培育下一代的方式 — 通过言语选择与气场，建立持久的影响力。
🎯
演讲技巧
从课堂PPT到舞台演讲 — 学习如何抓住注意力，传达打动人心的想法。
🙋
Q&A应答技巧
学会即兴思考，沉着应对突如其来的问题，把每一次问答都变成提升可信度的机会。
🤝
午餐交流
在课程开始前，于中午12时起与志同道合的同龄人及业界人士共进午餐，建立人脉。
